video_title: Dinners With DeMar - Ep. 9: Lonzo Ball

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan and Lonzo Ball discuss their time together on the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: the year that we were together the first year we had was one of the best times

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: First time I heard about Lonzo Ball, I was like, young, young kid. But I didn't really get close to him until obviously he came to the Bulls. That year that we were together, the first year we had, was one of the best times of my life.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: That year that we were together, the first year we had, was one of the best times of my life. DeMar has been a big brother to me, and he still is to this day.

quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan and Lonzo Ball reflect on their time as teammates in Chicago. DeMar says their first year together was one of the best times of his life.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan explains his decision to join the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't going to come until I saw the Bulls got us. It was a no-brainer for me

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: I wasn't going to come until I saw the Bulls got us. I didn't know that, though. I didn't know that. That was a, I just told you that story not too long ago, but I remember getting the call and they said it was going to go after you. And it was a no-brainer for me, bro.

quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan reveals he only decided to join the Bulls after finding out they were going after Lonzo Ball. He called it a no-brainer.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball's initial reaction to the Bulls' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: I was already excited honestly before you got there. I was just going there for Zach LaVine

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: I was already excited honestly before you got there. I was just going there for Zach LaVine. I was like, that's a great two-by for me to play with. Boom, boom, ball. It's cool, it's up. I needed a point guard anyway. But then once I seen that your shit, like I told you, I was on the beach running, breathing one day, I see my phone like DeMar DeRozan in the Bulls. What the fuck? So I'm like, we need that talent. So once that went down, I was like, oh, we're good. I felt, I felt we had everything you needed. We had two elite scorers, we had Vucevic, you know, picking pop, and then a facilitator that can guard, and Alex Caruso coming in and guard, too. So, I mean, it's unfortunate that that season got cut short.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: I was on the beach running, breathing one day, I see my phone like DeMar DeRozan in the Bulls. What the fuck? So I'm like, we need that talent.

quotes.social_post: Lonzo Ball on his initial reaction to the Bulls signing DeMar DeRozan: What the fuck? We need that talent. Lonzo felt they had everything needed to compete before that season was cut short.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the difficult decision to undergo knee surgery
quotes.excerpt: Either you knock you won't retire now and not get the surgery and you just going to call it
quotes.quote: On the doctor, pretty much told me like, either you knock you won't retire now and not get the surgery and you just going to call it, or you can try to get the surgery and it might work, it might not. So for me when I heard that, I was like, that's an easy choice. Worst case, shit, at least I'm going to be able to get these, like you going to be able to walk better, get upstairs. I was like, I can't even run with my daughter type shit. He was like, all that shit is going to be better at least. You know, as far as getting back on the court and do an NBA shit, like that's 50/50. But I'll take the chance, bro. You know, worst case, at least I'm going to be able to walk better.
quotes.social_post: Lonzo Ball opens up about his difficult decision to undergo knee surgery. He says the choice was easy because he wanted to be able to run with his daughter again, even if returning to the NBA was a 50/50 chance.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan discusses his mother's health struggles with lupus
quotes.excerpt: My mom been dealing with lupus since I was in high school
quotes.quote: My mom been dealing with lupus since I was in high school, and that's one thing that kind of pushed me and gave me my my belief that I had to make it and wanted to get the best medical care, attention for my moms. Everything I wanted to do was, you know, for my moms. To me, like my mom is, you know, that's one of the toughest women I ever came across in my whole entire life. You know, and to see her go through so much stuff and always be able to put a smile on her face, to see her happy, that's what it's all about.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan shares how his mother's battle with lupus motivated him to reach the NBA. He calls her one of the toughest women he has ever come across.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan reflects on his father's illness during the COVID-19 pandemic
quotes.excerpt: My dad ended up getting sick and you know it was during COVID so nobody could go to hospital
quotes.quote: My dad ended up getting sick and you know it was during COVID so nobody could go to hospital, bro. And it was it was my last year in San Antonio and you know we had to see my dad on, you know, a FaceTime this to the computer up in front of him and you know and and they used to kill me knowing that, you know, I couldn't be there, you know, feel my dad energy and know he was in the hospital all by himself, bro. And I never forget flying home. I think I played like in the game in Minnesota. I flew home, told me my dad was back in the hospital. I flew home just to be with moms and stuff.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan reflects on the pain of not being able to be with his father in the hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic. He recalls the difficulty of only being able to see him over FaceTime.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan on the evolution of NBA player salaries
quotes.excerpt: I remember when Kobe was the highest paid player he was arguably best player in league
quotes.quote: I remember when Kobe was the highest paid player he was arguably best player in league and he was getting $27 million. Now you got guys getting $30 million, that's role players, you know what I mean? That's eight and six, good locker room guy. Great locker room guy, you know what I mean? And it's like, from a financial standpoint, it's definitely better, you know, than how it used to be.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan on the evolution of NBA salaries: I remember when Kobe was the highest paid player getting 27 million. Now you got guys getting 30 million, that is role players.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the changing skill sets of modern NBA centers
quotes.excerpt: You can have a 6'5 center. Yeah, yeah. The shit that Vucevic did, small guards, come on
quotes.quote: I think even from a skill standpoint, not saying that the older players wasn't skilled, but you can have a 6'5 center. Yeah, yeah. The shit that Vucevic did, small guards, come on. We'll take you top 10, top five, fuck easy, easy. And that's why I think that as far as that, like there's no boundaries. Big man, you can do whatever you want now. You want to step back and shoot a three? Yep, step back and shoot a three. It's beautiful.
quotes.social_post: Lonzo Ball discusses the evolution of the modern NBA center, noting that there are no longer boundaries for big men who want to step back and shoot threes.
